title: myosotis scorpioides subsp. praecox
intro: Myosotis scorpioides subsp. praecox, commonly known as Early Forget-me-not, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is native to Europe and Western Asia, and its flowers are blue and white, resembling those of the more well-known Forget-me-not plant. The Early Forget-me-not has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of the Early Forget-me-not include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
